_comment: Settings for the CI typecheck job (.github/workflows/ci.yml).
platform.type = roblox turns on DataModel awareness, so game:GetService,
Instance.new and the sourcemap tree are understood rather than being any.
strictDatamodelTypes is OFF on purpose. With it on, the analyzer treats the
sourcemap as the complete shape of the DataModel and rejects every lookup of
an instance built at runtime -- and this game builds its entire world at
runtime (WorldService makes the street, the bases and the belt). It would be
hundreds of errors about instances that are genuinely there, which is the
fastest way to make a check people start ignoring.
